basis: GAP-62, F-61, G-11: every change from the submitted proposal, with the declared text, v1.0 behaviour, reason and evidence. Draft (IDEA-042 item 8) due 2026-10-19; final at the 2026-10-26 freeze. Rows requested in IDEA-040 and IDEA-041 were checked against this register on 2026-10-12 (IDEA-042 §4.3); details that exist only in owner code not yet integrated are added when it is integrated.

rows.declared: It is a bidirectional encoder with a typed decision head, which we fine-tune on our own point-in-time labels and calibrate on validation data.
rows.v1_behaviour: No trained decision model ships; H-02/EXP-001 remain NOT RUN. The October 11 rule-based EQUAL_WEIGHT baseline is retained as a conditional measured rehearsal fallback. The October 16 team choice is S1 at up to 95% gross (IDEA-075); its exact profile/parameters and qualification remain pending.
rows.reason: Training and evaluation data are on hold, so H-02 cannot be run; the proposal's own fallback (a pre-registered default) applies.

rows.declared: P(UP) and the margin P(UP) − P(DOWN) clear thresholds fit on validation data.
rows.v1_behaviour: Entries follow the equal-weight book: the time window, a fresh review, no unresolved red flag, the price-impact and entry-cost gates, and the 75% top-up threshold. There are no probability thresholds. This describes the October 11 EQUAL_WEIGHT baseline, not a frozen S1 entry profile. IDEA-075 selects the S1 strategy family at up to 95% gross; its trend inputs, weights, parameters, O1-O6 decisions and qualification remain separate.
rows.reason: No decision model (DEV-01); the team set an 80% invested target (B5) after F-115 made a mostly-cash default unsuitable. IQ02 distinguishes this dated decision from the later S1 choice; no new profile is adopted by this draft update.

rows.declared: Position size = 1% of equity ÷ (2 × expected 5-session volatility).
rows.v1_behaviour: Equal weight: four names at 20% of equity each (80% gross); topped up while gross is below 75%; never resized on drift. This is the retained EQUAL_WEIGHT baseline. The October 16 S1 family choice uses volatility-weighted sizing at up to 95% gross; name count, weights, caps and remaining parameters are not finalized (IDEA-075 sections 12/16).
rows.reason: Team decision B5 (Option 1); equal weight needs no estimate and fits the declared caps. IQ02 distinguishes this dated decision from the later S1 choice; no new profile is adopted by this draft update.

rows.declared: ≤ 80% gross exposure, so at least 20% stays in cash.
rows.v1_behaviour: 80% gross is a buy-time ceiling. Price drift may take gross above it; forced trims start only above 25% per name or 90% gross. This is the EQUAL_WEIGHT baseline. The October 16 S1 choice permits up to 95% target gross, changing the submitted cash floor further; its exact name/position/drift limits remain proposals until adopted (IDEA-075 sections 12/14/16).
rows.reason: Avoids cap-trim micro-trades that would sell on every small rally (IDEA-017); decided with the B5 rebalance rule. IQ02 distinguishes this dated decision from the later S1 choice; no new profile is adopted by this draft update.

rows.declared: The order is ≤ 10% of the quoted depth.
rows.v1_behaviour: Price-impact limit: impact ≤ min(50 bp, 2 × logged median) and total entry cost (spread + impact + gas ÷ size) ≤ 50 bp.
rows.reason: The Web3 Open API quote has no depth field; the impact fields replace it.

rows.declared: licensed historical daily prices of the underlying US shares, for training labels. The vendor will be declared at onboarding.
rows.v1_behaviour: No licensed share-price vendor. Sizing and session inputs use the kit's own bStock token candles (Web3 Open API).
rows.reason: Zero paid budget and kit-first data; no trained model needs share-price labels (DEV-01).

rows.declared: a confident DOWN signal on a held name,
rows.v1_behaviour: Exits: red-flag Class 1 (verified 8-K Item 4.02) sells; Class 2 (Items 1.05, 2.06) blocks new buys for 5 sessions without a forced sale; risk-limit triggers; and the end-of-run flatten finished by 2026-11-11 15:00 UTC. A name may be bought again once its finding is corrected or withdrawn at the source.
rows.reason: No decision model to give a DOWN signal (DEV-01); the LLM only assesses evidence (D-11); flat at the end so both scoring readings agree (C4).

rows.declared: `fetch_issuer_release`
rows.v1_behaviour: Three tools: fetch_document, prior_context, compare_facts. No issuer-release tool; feature lookup is internal context construction, not a tool.
rows.reason: Issuer newsroom terms do not allow automated use; the three-tool limit is kept.

rows.declared: **GDELT news events:** the second independent source.
rows.v1_behaviour: GDELT is disabled. Official free sources (SEC press, Federal Register, DOJ, European Commission) are recorded as SHADOW_ONLY event flags; EDGAR stays the only source of verified company claims.
rows.reason: Copies of a common release are not independent corroboration; the official sources have clear terms.

rows.declared: **FRED/ALFRED macro data:** vintage data, so each value is as it was known at the time.
rows.v1_behaviour: Not used.
rows.reason: FRED terms prohibit machine-learning use, and no trained model ships (DEV-01).

rows.declared: **Issuer investor-relations releases and RSS feeds.**
rows.v1_behaviour: Not fetched (issuer-newsrooms disabled in the source register).
rows.reason: Issuer terms do not allow automated use.

rows.declared: **Small self-hosted finance sentiment/relevance model:** used for triage.
rows.v1_behaviour: Not shipped.
rows.reason: No model-layer track passed a gate; the evidence path is deterministic verification plus an assessment-only model (or the deterministic assessor).

rows.declared: Improvements are versioned releases, at most one a day, each run in shadow first.
rows.v1_behaviour: No releases during the scored run: the build registered at final activation runs unchanged.
rows.reason: Organiser answer: improve during development only.

rows.declared: Humans can halt the agent but never trade.
rows.v1_behaviour: No human action during the run. HALT is autonomous code (clock, delivery deadline, repeated failures; integrity quarantines), and a supervisor restarts the same build after a crash, each logged as an incident.
rows.reason: F-117 freezes the scored build; F-124 confirms automatic engineering restarts of that same version and forbids manual restarts. Standby, crash-loop and restore policy acceptance remains separate (DEV-18 / IDEA-066).

rows.declared: registered safe-mode build
rows.v1_behaviour: No separate safe-mode build; safe behaviour (HALT, holds) is inside the one registered build.
rows.reason: Only one build may run unchanged during the run.

rows.declared: Web3 API quote/build/simulate
rows.v1_behaviour: Kit flow: quote → approve exactly the order amount → re-quote → gas estimate → swap; recovery by nonce and transaction hash.
rows.reason: The Web3 Open API has no build/simulate or order-hash flow for bStocks.

rows.declared: The challenge branch is protected: no force-pushes and no rewrites.
rows.v1_behaviour: No force-pushes and no rewrites, enforced by the team rule; GitHub branch protection is not available on the plan.
rows.reason: Checked 2026-10-03: branch protection unavailable on the repository's plan.

rows.declared: The deployment is one primary runtime plus a fenced cold standby.
rows.v1_behaviour: OPEN: primary supervisor restart is built and historical unsigned primary operation is recorded (IDEA-066 PC-AWS06-08 / PC-DEPLOY02). No fenced cold-standby acceptance is recorded. PC-OPS01 proposes omitting it; that proposal, crash-loop and restore policies still await Isaac C05 and Keegan final acceptance.
rows.reason: AWS exploration/provisioning is no longer the pending decision. GAP-02 remains open for the proposed deviation and recovery-policy acceptance; standby promotion remains disabled.

rows.declared: **Hosted reasoning LLM for the evidence step:**
rows.v1_behaviour: Opt-in unsigned AIandRouting.v3 trial: OpenAI gpt-6.1-sol medium primary; independent high-effort AIand Kimi K3 and GLM-5.3 review/fallback. IDEA-083 / DEV-22 runs external reviewers concurrently: an ASSESSED primary stands unless a reviewer dissents; without one, fallback uses fixed reviewer precedence. All claims remain deterministically verified. Default remains deterministic shadow until prepared routing is installed. Signed/scored adoption is pending.
rows.reason: User selects OpenAI-primary v3 and Yao approved Keith's PR168 trial protocol (PC-REL05). V3 paces the full US$50 allocation including US$2 owner-reported prior spend, with no permanent reserve; legacy v2 limits remain separate. Budget/stop-cap enforcement is implemented and offline-tested (IDEA-066); actual account/rights reconciliation, new exact-host enforcement checks, route measurements and final adoption remain pending.

rows.declared: an event-calendar planner,
rows.v1_behaviour: Omitted: no per-class macro/earnings event-calendar planner ships. In the existing S1 limiter the SCHEDULED_EVENT evidence class alone cannot cut exposure; IDEA-075 O5 stays a separate decision. The frozen session/execution windows, the terminal schedule and every market, terminal and execution-window safety gate stay in force; they are not presented as a planner.
rows.reason: Decided 2026-10-19 by Keegan, accepting the PC-OPS01 recommendation: a planner needs a trusted event source with provenance, per-class action/freshness/window rules, conflict precedence, replay/audit fields and tests, which cannot be built and qualified before the Oct 22 decision cut. Final declaration wording and FINAL status follow at C10 with the other rows.

rows.declared: A gas-reserve floor keeps enough gas for exits.
rows.v1_behaviour: The floor is kept by gas top-up rounds: when BNB falls below the floor, one USDT → BNB swap runs as its own logged round (order symbol BNB, a cot saying it is a gas top-up). BNB is a resource, not a position. First gas follows F-120: pre-first-agent-trade MetaMask USDT to BNB seeding, gas paid in USDT, recorded as a funding note rather than an ai-seeds round; never after the scored run starts. This is an answered bootstrap procedure, not proof that funding occurred. Native-route qualification and measured reserve/top-up values remain pending.
rows.reason: Funding is USDT only and gas is BNB only; the proposal did not say how the floor is refilled.

rows.declared: The loop is capped at 6 calls and 60 s per decision.
rows.v1_behaviour: Evidence assessments accept at most 180 s; OpenAI-preferred routing gives its primary at most 60 s and one third of the decision budget, then runs two independent reviewers concurrently with at most 90 s each. One global six-tool-call allowance is deterministically partitioned. Stage deadline results are separate from actual worker cleanup; late replies never restore authority. B11 preserves selected primary content in an immutable linked result under a canonical routed envelope.
rows.reason: IDEA-083: hosted high-effort review exhausted the previous 60 s serial budget despite an assessed primary. Yao approved longer budgets/parallel review/B11; Isaac approved separate routed identity with unchanged primary identity/content on 2026-10-19. Legacy AIand-first selection remains historical, without B11 changes.

rows.declared: The order aborts if quoted slippage exceeds its cap.
rows.v1_behaviour: The kit router (a diamond proxy) and its swap facet publish no verified source, so the on-chain enforcement of the minimum output, the recipient and the deadline is not proven, and the wallet address is not in the swap calldata. In untrusted-router mode the agent still refuses any quote whose minimum is below the cap, checks the full calldata layout (outer and inner economics agree), and before every swap step re-checks on chain that the facet and code are the pinned ones and that the router's allowance is at most this swap's amount (zero for every other token). A fill below its minimum is never booked; it withholds all further signing. LD06 additionally implements optional zero-only cleanup before the next valid stock intent, at most once per eligible token under original authority and gas budget, with independent execution/signer opt-ins defaulting false. Cleanup hashes are supporting approval audit facts, never swap orders. Independent review, measured gas/reserve/timing and host acceptance are still required; no installed configuration enables it.
rows.reason: Keegan selected this implementation direction on 2026-10-19 (IDEA-070 B02-U); Isaac accepted API-provided router behavior in B09-TRUST01 (PR196). Source guarantees remain unavailable. Exact approvals, signer input/fee caps and settlement checks constrain submitted authority and detect anomalies, but do not establish a maximum loss or recover lost funds. Actual policy/hash review, measured B09/#44 acceptance, allowance/abnormal-fill disposition and gas scope remain open. This declaration remains DRAFT.
